transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. I'm here because I've been suffering from an intense, overwhelming fear of heights for the past two years and two months. It has become really difficult to deal with, so I decided it was time to seek some help.
